sections.heading: Background
sections.text: In this psychology case, attention and learning habits are examined through how long-term decisions are made and reviewed. The programme's apparent simplicity conceals a layered institutional arrangement in which responsibility is deliberately dispersed. The account refers to students, researchers, and educators and records Topic 388, paragraph 1, detail 1. The account refers to students, researchers, and educators and records Topic 388, paragraph 1, detail 2. The account refers to students, researchers, and educators and records Topic 388, paragraph 1, detail 3. The disagreement is partly methodological: each side treats a different timescale and unit of analysis as decisive. The account refers to students, researchers, and educators and records Topic 388, paragraph 1, detail 4. The account refers to students, researchers, and educators and records Topic 388, paragraph 1, detail 5.
